summary: Vantage Corp (Singapore) filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of its $1.0 million share repurchase program. Under the program, the company repurchased 1,076,610 Class A ordinary shares at an aggregate net cost of US$997,897.72, executed in open-market purchases from November 5, 2025 to June 30, 2026. The program was authorized and previously announced; no specific per-share price or premium is disclosed. CEO Andresian D Rozario stated the repurchases reflect management's belief that shares are undervalued. As a completed open-market buyback with no tender or fixed-price terms, this is a routine capital return. What to watch: future buyback authorizations or alternative capital allocation strategies.
